ru.name: Повседневность
ru.description: Повседневные занятия, отношения и небольшие перемены в жизни.

en.name: Everyday life
en.description: Everyday activities, relationships and small changes.

genres.themes: Everyday details, ordinary conversations and meaningful small changes.

ru.name: Семейная сага
ru.description: История семьи на протяжении лет и поколений. Будущие браки, дети и переходы героя заранее не определены.

en.name: Family saga
en.description: Family ties across generations, without predetermined marriages or children.

genres.themes: Family ties, intergenerational perspectives and lasting consequences.

ru.name: Романтика
ru.description: Сближение и личные отношения, когда они согласуются с желаниями персонажей и вашим замыслом.

en.name: Romance
en.description: Closeness and relationships consistent with character intentions.

genres.themes: Nuanced relationships, dialogue and emotional subtext; attraction is never guaranteed.

ru.name: Драма
ru.description: Внутренние противоречия и сложные отношения без обязательной трагедии.

en.name: Drama
en.description: Conflicting values and relationships without mandatory tragedy.

genres.themes: Conflicting values, difficult choices and their personal consequences.

ru.name: Детектив
ru.description: Наблюдения, улики и поиск объяснений. Преступление не обязательно.

en.name: Detective
en.description: Clues and competing explanations; crime is optional.

genres.themes: Questions, clues and competing explanations grounded in available knowledge.

ru.name: Триллер
ru.description: Ожидание, неопределённость и напряжение без предрешённого насилия.

en.name: Thriller
en.description: Suspense and uncertainty without predetermined violence.

genres.themes: Uncertainty, suspense and consequential tension; constant crime is unnecessary.

ru.name: Научная фантастика
ru.description: Научные идеи, технологии и их влияние на жизнь общества.

en.name: Science fiction
en.description: Science, technology and their human consequences.

genres.themes: Speculative ideas and their human consequences within established world rules.

ru.name: Фэнтези
ru.description: Необычный мир и возможное волшебство в пределах заданных правил.

en.name: Fantasy
en.description: Wonder within the established rules of the world.

genres.themes: Wonder, imagination and the lived consequences of the established fantastic world.

ru.name: Ужасы
ru.description: Неизвестность и тревожная атмосфера. Не задаёт уровень риска или обязательные травмы.

en.name: Horror
en.description: Unease and the unknown; does not set risk or require injuries.

genres.themes: Unease, vulnerability and the unfamiliar; harm is not required.

ru.name: Приключения
ru.description: Открытия, путешествия и новые обстоятельства без обязательного героического подвига.

en.name: Adventure
en.description: Discovery and exploration without mandatory heroism.

genres.themes: Discovery, exploration and encounters with meaningful consequences.

ru.name: Постапокалипсис
ru.description: Жизнь после крупных перемен мира; причины и последствия определяет ваш замысел.

en.name: Post-apocalyptic
en.description: Life after major disruption; the world defines its causes.

genres.themes: Life after disruption, adaptation and rebuilding human connections.

ru.name: Исторический
ru.description: Жизнь в выбранной эпохе. Страна, даты и биографии не выводятся из названия жанра.

en.name: Historical
en.description: Life in the established era, without inventing dates or biographies.

genres.themes: Lived experience and social detail consistent with the established era.

ru.name: Психологическая драма
ru.description: Внутренние противоречия, субъективный опыт и тонкие перемены.

en.name: Psychological drama
en.description: Inner conflict, subjective experience and subtle changes.

genres.themes: Subjective experience, inner tensions and subtle emotional shifts; never assign player decisions.

ru.name: Политическая драма
ru.description: Убеждения, публичные решения и их человеческая цена.

en.name: Political drama
en.description: Beliefs, public choices and their human cost.

genres.themes: Competing public values, institutions and personal costs of political choices without predetermined winners.

ru.name: Криминальная драма
ru.description: Лояльность, ответственность и последствия нарушения закона.

en.name: Crime drama
en.description: Loyalty, responsibility and consequences around the law.

genres.themes: Loyalty, accountability and tensions around established laws; do not require crimes or violence.

ru.name: Космическая опера
ru.description: Масштабные истории и далёкие горизонты в рамках заданного мира.

en.name: Space opera
en.description: Expansive stories and distant horizons within the authored world.

genres.themes: Expansive perspectives, distant connections and personal stakes; do not invent spaceflight or technology.

ru.name: Антиутопия
ru.description: Общественное давление, свобода и цена привычного порядка.

en.name: Dystopia
en.description: Social pressure, freedom and the cost of accepted order.

genres.themes: Tensions between social order and individual freedom; no mandatory oppression, rebellion or collapse.

ru.name: Альтернативная история
ru.description: Последствия исторических развилок, заданных автором.

en.name: Alternate history
en.description: Consequences of historical divergences established by the author.

genres.themes: Explore consequences of authored historical divergences without inventing dates, borders or past events.

ru.name: Киберпанк
ru.description: Личность, неравенство и власть технологий, если они есть в мире.

en.name: Cyberpunk
en.description: Identity, inequality and technological power where the world supports it.

genres.themes: Identity, inequality and mediated power; never introduce technologies or implants absent from world canon.

ru.name: Тёмное фэнтези
ru.description: Неоднозначность и тревожное чудо без обязательной жестокости.

en.name: Dark fantasy
en.description: Ambiguity and unsettling wonder without mandatory cruelty.

genres.themes: Moral ambiguity and unsettling wonder within established rules; neither magic nor cruelty is required.

ru.name: Городское фэнтези
ru.description: Необычное рядом с привычной городской жизнью.

en.name: Urban fantasy
en.description: The unusual alongside familiar urban life.

genres.themes: Contrasts between familiar routines and established wonders; do not create cities or magical rules.

ru.name: Эпическое фэнтези
ru.description: Широкий масштаб и переплетение судеб без обязательного пророчества.

en.name: Epic fantasy
en.description: Broad scope and intersecting lives without a required prophecy.

genres.themes: Interwoven lives and far-reaching stakes; no mandatory prophecy, chosen hero, war or supernatural powers.

ru.name: Мистика
ru.description: Совпадения, неоднозначные знаки и граница объяснимого.

en.name: Mysticism
en.description: Coincidences, ambiguous signs and the limits of explanation.

genres.themes: Ambiguous signs and competing interpretations of the unfamiliar; do not confirm supernatural causes.

ru.name: Готика
ru.description: Тени прошлого, выразительные места и тревожные семейные истории.

en.name: Gothic
en.description: Shadows of the past, evocative places and uneasy family histories.

genres.themes: Atmospheric places, traces of the past and uneasy intimacy; no mandatory curses, secrets or deaths.

ru.name: Сверхъестественный триллер
ru.description: Напряжение вокруг необъяснимого без навязывания его природы.

en.name: Supernatural thriller
en.description: Suspense around the unexplained without imposing its nature.

genres.themes: Suspense around unexplained experiences; supernatural explanations remain subject to canon and available knowledge.

ru.name: Династическая сага
ru.description: Наследие рода, преемственность и личные интересы поколений.

en.name: Dynastic saga
en.description: Dynastic legacy, continuity and personal interests across generations.

genres.themes: Legacy, continuity and generational interests; never require heirs, marriages or succession outcomes.

ru.name: Придворные интриги
ru.description: Репутация, влияние и скрытые интересы в установленном круге власти.

en.name: Court intrigue
en.description: Reputation, influence and private interests around established power.

genres.themes: Reputation, influence and competing interests around existing power structures; no compulsory plots or betrayals.

ru.name: Военная драма
ru.description: Долг, близость и человеческий опыт конфликтов, уже заданных миром.

en.name: War drama
en.description: Duty, bonds and human experiences of conflicts established in the world.

genres.themes: Human perspectives on established conflicts, duty and bonds; never create wars or require casualties.

ru.name: Музыкальная драма
ru.description: Творческий голос, совместная работа и отношения вокруг музыки.

en.name: Music drama
en.description: Creative voice, collaboration and relationships around music.

genres.themes: Creative voice, musical collaboration and personal stakes; no mandatory talent, fame or career choices.

ru.name: Спортивная драма
ru.description: Мастерство, соперничество и повседневная работа над собой.

en.name: Sports drama
en.description: Skill, rivalry and everyday practice.

genres.themes: Practice, teamwork and rivalry; do not guarantee victories, injuries or player ambition.

ru.name: Бизнес-драма
ru.description: Предпринимательство, ответственность и отношения в работе.

en.name: Business drama
en.description: Enterprise, responsibility and working relationships.

genres.themes: Enterprise, responsibility and competing professional interests without prescribed success, failure or misconduct.

ru.name: Комедия
ru.description: Юмор характеров, диалогов и повседневных несовпадений.

en.name: Comedy
en.description: Humour in characters, dialogue and everyday incongruities.

genres.themes: Characterful dialogue and situational incongruities; humour is optional and never overrides personality or consent.

ru.name: Сатира
ru.description: Иронический взгляд на общественные привычки и противоречия.

en.name: Satire
en.description: An ironic view of social habits and contradictions.

genres.themes: Irony around established social habits and contradictions without turning characters into compulsory caricatures.

ru.name: Чёрная комедия
ru.description: Мрачная ирония и абсурд без обязательных трагедий.

en.name: Black comedy
en.description: Dark irony and absurdity without mandatory tragedy.

genres.themes: Dark irony and uncomfortable incongruities; no required deaths, cruelty or trivialisation of character experience.

ru.name: Выживание
ru.description: Практические решения, ресурсы и взаимопомощь в текущих условиях.

en.name: Survival
en.description: Practical choices, resources and mutual support in current conditions.

genres.themes: Practical adaptation and mutual support under established conditions; never manufacture scarcity, injury or disasters.

ru.name: Исследование
ru.description: Любопытство, наблюдения и постепенное открытие мира.

en.name: Exploration
en.description: Curiosity, observation and gradual discovery of the world.

genres.themes: Curiosity, careful observation and discovery limited by viewpoint and knowledge; no guaranteed revelations.

ru.name: Морские приключения
ru.description: Пути по воде, команды и встречи, когда это допускает мир.

en.name: Nautical adventure
en.description: Waterborne journeys, crews and encounters where the world allows them.

genres.themes: Waterborne perspectives, cooperation and encounters where supported by canon; do not invent seas, ships or storms.

ru.name: Свой жанр
ru.description: Направление задаётся вашим описанием ниже.

en.name: Custom genre
en.description: Themes from your description below.
